description: PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector' for collecting and formatting HTML purification errors, including error reporting, error structuring, and HTML formatted error output.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector
classes.description: Class for collecting, structuring, and formatting errors encountered during HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error collector with a given context, setting locale, errors, and internal stacks.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Records an error message with severity, associates it with current token and position, and structures it for later formatting.

methods.name: getRaw
methods.description: Returns the raw errors array for custom formatting.

methods.name: getHTMLFormatted
methods.description: Generates an HTML representation of the collected errors, optionally recursively formatting nested error structures.

methods.name: _renderStruct
methods.description: Recursively renders error structures into HTML strings for display.
